subject: Preflight: CleverSupply vendor onboarding — COI, cyber liability & PO path
messages:
From: Aaron Feldman <aaron@cleversupply.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor packet submitted — initial COI + cyber question

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for walking us through the onboarding form this morning. We've attached our standard insurance packet for your review (CleverSupply_CertificateofInsurance.pdf) and a short subcontractor roster. A few quick clarifications so we can get the PO and portal access squared away on our side: 

- COI: We included general liability and professional liability limits. Do you require an Additional Insured endorsement on the GL? If so, can you confirm the exact wording or certificate holder?
- Cyber: Our broker included a cyber liability schedule but the limit is $1M. Is that acceptable for Redwood's procurement minimums, or do you require $2M?
- PO timing: If documents look good, what's the usual lead time to issue a conditional PO so we can start provisioning?

I've attached: CleverSupply_CertificateofInsurance.pdf (pdf), CleverSupply_Subcontractor_List.xlsx (xls).

Happy to hop on a quick call if it speeds things up.

Cheers,
Aaron Feldman
Director of Ops
CleverSupply Inc.

Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor packet submitted — initial COI + cyber question

Hi Aaron — thanks for sending these over and for the summary. Looping in Procurement and Risk so we can triage quickly. Next steps on our side: 

1) I'll run the COI through our intake checklist. For GL Additional Insured we typically ask for: "Redwood Inference and its subsidiaries, partners, and clients — as additional insured for ongoing operations." If your broker prefers a certificate holder name instead, we can accept "Redwood Inference, Inc., 5000 Redwood Way, San Francisco, CA."
2) Cyber limit: our default is 2M for vendors with access to customer data. If CleverSupply only needs a conditional PO to begin non-production work, we can issue a conditional PO with the provision to increase cyber to 2M prior to production cutover.
3) Claims history: can you share the last three years' claims summary? That helps speed formal approval.

We also have a vendor portal where you can upload documents directly — I'll send the upload link after procurement confirms the request. For now, I've attached this thread to PROC-7654 (see link).

Priya
Vendor Onboarding | Redwood Inference
